wave.source_archive: Minerva_Myrient/No-Intro/Nintendo - Game Boy Advance/Kingdom Hearts - Chain of Memories (USA).zip
wave.compiler: agbcc (pret/agbcc, -O2) + binutils 2.10 legacy assembler; libgcc/libc members prebuilt
wave.notes: Truth = typed FUNC/THUMB_FUNC symbols of the ELF built on nih-vps-u (ninja; ROM sha1 identical to the delivered file; `ninja` CHECK step OK). Sizes are the ELF symbol sizes; 35 asm functions carry no size (0). verified=1 for functions in units compiled from C (src/*.c); asm units (m4a_1, libagbsyscall, transform*, movie_codec blob) and libgcc/libc members are verified=0. movie_codec.o symbols (MovieDeltaCodecStart etc., 7) are data-and-code blobs labelled FUNC by the repo and are verified=0. No DWARF in this build, so no types/. All code is in one ROM-resident module at 0x08000000 (no IWRAM/EWRAM-copied code; the one `.text` ELF section is the whole ROM).

wave.compiler: mwccarm 3.0 build 139 (a few precompiled-middleware units with an older mwccarm per config/arm9/file_compilers.json), mwldarm
wave.notes: Restaged from the Europe ROM (the earlier USA YKGE file did not match this repo: 40/4301 ARM9 relocations). khdays-decomp builds only the EU ROM (YKGP; CONTRIBUTING.md SHA-1 6fae8f5bbe80114b4e2535260eab5f4d0fc8a844, which the delivered file has). Truth = ds-decomp config/arm9: symbols.txt `kind:function` rows (sizes, arm/thumb from dsd) for the ARM9 static module, ITCM autoload (module main, ITCM addresses 0x01ff8xxx) and the ARM9 overlays (modules ov<N>, own program per overlay at its RAM address). Every one of the 23233 functions lies in a delinks.txt unit marked `complete` (100% linked): verified=1. The repo's relocs.txt call/branch relocations all match the EU ROM bytes (reloc_check: main 4301/4301, overlays 97970/97970). No ARM7 config in the repo. DTCM has no functions. Ranges follow m21 nds-pokeheartgold-arm9 (ITCM bank + static module through bss). No DWARF/types.
